Frequently asked

How far is the studio from Rio Grande City?

From Rio Grande City, head east on US 83 through Sullivan City and continue on I-2/US 83 through Palmview and Mission to our private studio in the McAllen area; the whole drive takes about 45–50 minutes. The exact session location is shared after booking.

Is a 2–3 hour newborn session too long after the drive from Rio Grande City?

The session is planned with that in mind. Every session is baby-led, with breaks to feed and soothe whenever your newborn needs them, so the 2–3 hours stretch to fit your baby. Feeding just before you leave Rio Grande City helps, and you can feed again in the private studio before posing begins.

Can we come from Rio Grande City on a Saturday for a baby or cake smash session?

Yes. Sessions run Monday–Saturday by appointment, so a Saturday drive down US 83 can fit around the workweek. Reach out early through the online form or by call or text at (409) 354-3075 to find a date for Fairytale, a Pixie Dust milestone or the first-birthday Cake Smash.

What if my baby arrives early or late?

That’s completely normal — babies keep their own schedule! Just let us know when your little one arrives and we’ll set your session within that ideal newborn window.

Is newborn photography safe?

Safety comes before any photo. With 15+ years of experience and hundreds of babies photographed, Adrisabel is trained in safe newborn posing: every pose is supported, the studio is kept warm and clean, and a parent is always close by.

When will I receive my photos?

Your edited images are delivered within one week of your session.

What is the Pixie Dust milestone package?

Pixie Dust is 5 milestone sessions during baby’s first year (babies 1–11 months). Choose one schedule — Option A: 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9 months, or Option B: 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 months. Each session includes 8 edited images, 1 outfit and 1 backdrop, and siblings and parents are included. The 1-year Cake Smash is not included.

What is the best age for baby photos?

Every stage is worth celebrating! Our Fairytale session is made for babies 2–11 months — the months of first smiles, giggles and sitting up — and Cake Smash celebrates the first birthday.

Good to know

Where are sessions held?

In our private studio in the McAllen area — the exact session location is shared after booking. Seaside Beach family sessions take place on South Padre Island.

My town isn’t listed — can I still book?

Of course. Adrisabel photographs families from all over the Rio Grande Valley. Send a booking request or call/text (409) 354-3075 and we’ll help you plan your session.

How do I plan the drive with a newborn?

We schedule newborn sessions around your baby’s feeds, so you can feed right before you leave and again when you arrive. There’s no rush — the session moves at your baby’s pace.

When should I book?

Reach out during your second or third trimester so we can save a spot around your due date. Newborn portraits are best 5–14 days after birth.

But your photos will. Reach out today to check availability and reserve your date — we’d love to capture this chapter with you.

Privacy policy

Last updated: September 2026

This policy explains what information Adrisabel Photography (“we”, “us”) collects through adrisabel.com and how we use it. If you have any questions, contact us at adrianaisabelphoto@gmail.com or (409) 354-3075.

Information you give us

When you send a booking request or contact us, we collect the details you choose to share — such as your name, phone number, email address, the session you’re interested in, your preferred date and time, your baby’s due date or birthday, and any notes. Booking requests are delivered to our inbox through our form provider, Formspree.

How we use it

  • To reply to you, answer your questions and schedule your session.
  • To send you information about your booking and your photos.
  • To keep basic records of our sessions and payments.

We do not sell your personal information.

Analytics and advertising

Our website uses Google Tag Manager and related Google tools to understand how visitors use the site and to measure our advertising (for example, whether a booking request was sent after clicking an ad). These tools may use cookies or similar technologies. You can manage cookies in your browser settings and learn more about how Google uses information at policies.google.com.

Your choices

You may ask us to access, correct or delete the personal information you have shared with us by emailing adrianaisabelphoto@gmail.com.

Children’s privacy

Our website is intended for parents and guardians. We do not knowingly collect personal information directly from children.

Do you offer beach sessions?

Yes! Our Seaside Beach family session takes place at South Padre Island and includes 15 edited photos. See the beach session page for details.

How do I reserve my session?

Send a request through our online booking form or call/text (409) 354-3075. We’ll confirm the date and time with you, and a 50% deposit via Zelle reserves your spot. The balance is due on session day.

Can I get more photos than my package includes?

Of course. Extra edited photos can be added to any session, so you never have to leave a favorite behind.

How do I choose my photos?

At the end of your session we sit together and help you pick your favorite images for editing. There’s no proof gallery to sort through at home — every image is hand-selected, curated and edited with care.

When will I receive my photos?

I’ve been photographing professionally for more than 15 years, and somewhere along the way I fell completely in love with newborn and baby photography. There’s nothing quite like cradling a week-old baby, gently settling them into a soft wrap, and creating an image their parents will treasure for the rest of their lives.

I’ve photographed hundreds of babies — each one unique, each session different, each family trusting me with something incredibly precious. That trust is something I never take lightly.

My approach is simple: patience first, safety always, and genuine love for every baby who comes through my studio. I don’t rush and I don’t force poses. I let your baby lead, and I capture the beauty that unfolds naturally.

When I’m not behind the camera, I’m probably planning my next set, curating new props, or daydreaming about tiny baby toes. This isn’t just my job — it’s the thing that lights me up every single day.

Common questions

Frequently asked

How much does newborn photography cost?

We offer two newborn packages: Sunshine (baby only · 8 edited photos · 2 outfits · 2 backdrops) and Wonderland with siblings and parents (15 edited photos · 2 outfits · 4 backdrops). Send a booking request or call/text (409) 354-3075 and we’ll share current package details. See all sessions.

How do I reserve my session?

Send a request through our online booking form or call/text (409) 354-3075. We’ll confirm the date and time with you, and a 50% deposit via Zelle reserves your spot. The balance is due on session day.

When should I book my newborn session?

Reach out during your second or third trimester so we can save a spot around your due date. Newborn portraits are best taken 5–14 days after birth, when babies are sleepiest and most comfortable in those soft, curled-up poses.

How long does a newborn session take?

Newborn sessions usually take about 2–3 hours. We never rush — there’s time for feeding, cuddles, soothing and diaper changes, and your baby sets the pace.

Is newborn photography safe?

Safety comes before any photo. With 15+ years of experience and hundreds of babies photographed, Adrisabel is trained in safe newborn posing: every pose is supported, the studio is kept warm and clean, and a parent is always close by.

What is the Pixie Dust milestone package?

Pixie Dust is 5 milestone sessions during baby’s first year (babies 1–11 months). Choose one schedule — Option A: 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9 months, or Option B: 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 months. Each session includes 8 edited images, 1 outfit and 1 backdrop, and siblings and parents are included. The 1-year Cake Smash is not included.

Do you offer beach sessions?

Yes! Our Seaside Beach family session takes place at South Padre Island and includes 15 edited photos. See the beach session page for details.

How do I choose my photos?

At the end of your session we sit together and help you pick your favorite images for editing. There’s no proof gallery to sort through at home — every image is hand-selected, curated and edited with care.
